instruction.text: Change the sentences into the simple future tense.

atoms.a: <u>Did</u> you buy a present for me?
atoms.b: ((Will)) you buy a present for me?

atoms.a: Emil <u>will be visiting</u> his grandmother at the care home today.
atoms.b: Emil ((will_visit)) his grandmother at the care home today.

atoms.a: Phoebe<u> stayed</u> at ours for a sleepover.
atoms.b: Phoebe ((will_stay)) at ours for a sleepover.

atoms.a: Jiwon <u>has trained</u> her kittens to use the litterbox.
atoms.b: Jiwon ((will_train)) her kittens to use the litterbox.

atoms.a: We <u>are doing</u> what we can to preserve historical sites.
atoms.b: We ((will_do)) what we can to preserve historical sites.
